title: Extension Registry
description: Schema for the vendor extension registry (extensions/registry.json). Each entry documents a vendor-specific extension field that uses the x-<vendor>. prefix namespace.

owner_repo.description: Repository that owns this extension, e.g. Mnesis-Labs/Mnesis-Iris

since.description: Date when the extension was first introduced (YYYY-MM-DD)

promotion_status.description: registered = still a vendor extension; promoted = promoted to a standard field; deprecated = being retired

promoted_to.description: Standard field name if promotion_status is 'promoted'

promoted_in_issue.description: Issue number or link that promoted this extension

type.description: Expected JSON type of the field value, e.g. float[63], string
